records.name: Kazuma Kiryu
records.sourceReference: Kiryu Kiwami 2016 costume and physical Dragon style; project special is an authored physical combination, not a claim to a uniquely named original technique.
records.identity: Kazuma Kiryu in Yakuza Kiwami 2016: mature Japanese game character, short black slicked-back hair, light grey suit with matching grey trousers, open-collar burgundy shirt and light shoes. Broad athletic adult build. Empty hands, compact Dragon of Dojima boxing/brawling stance. No weapon.
records.superAction: A physical Dragon of Dojima close combination: planted guard, shoulder and hip turn into a straight punch, a second compact body hook, then controlled recovery. No animal manifestation, beam or magical attack.
records.finale: The finale is a non-graphic physical finishing demonstration: lower ready stance, a forward straight punch, a short knee lift and planted recovery. No victim or blood.

provenance.sourceReference: Yakuza : Kazuma Kiryu emploie le style de combat Dragon de Dojima ; combo rapproché adapté, sans coup nommé inventé ni arme de lame substituée à son corps-à-corps.

records.prompt:
Create ONE native hand-drawn detailed 2D pixel-art fighting-game sprite atlas on a truly transparent alpha background. This is an actual new drawing of a fictional video-game character, not an actor portrait. Preserve the explicitly specified game version. Use the attached old game sprite only for visual continuity; repair its missing weapon or wrong clothing according to this exact description.
CHARACTER: Kazuma Kiryu in Yakuza Kiwami 2016: mature Japanese game character, short black slicked-back hair, light grey suit with matching grey trousers, open-collar burgundy shirt and light shoes. Broad athletic adult build. Empty hands, compact Dragon of Dojima boxing/brawling stance. No weapon.
LAYOUT IS MANDATORY: EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS and EXACTLY 8 ROWS = 32 different full-body native poses. Make a tall portrait atlas 1024 by 2048 pixels, eight equal horizontal rows. Each of the 32 cells is independent, with transparent gutters at least 18px, all heads, hair, hands, weapons and feet fully inside its own cell. No pose touches a canvas edge, no contact between neighboring sprites. Standing body height about 190px in a 256px cell. Keep a SINGLE consistent native body scale across the entire sheet; crouches remain naturally shorter. Ground baseline about244 per cell. Face to the RIGHT for combat poses. Clear readable face and native hands, legs and equipment. No labels, no text, numbers, floor, opaque panels or background scenery. Every cell must visibly change torso, arms, legs or head: no duplicated pose, no simple translation of a repeated sprite.
EIGHT ROWS IN THIS EXACT ORDER, four DIFFERENT successive poses in EACH:
ROW1 INTRO: enters half-step, squares shoulders, checks grip or raises fists, settles into ready stance.
ROW2 OUTRO: relaxes guard, turns three-quarter away, takes a departing step, final composed look back.
ROW3 ROUND VICTORY: exhales, modest fist or bat acknowledgement, distinct relieved shoulder turn, relaxed reset.
ROW4 ROUND DEFEAT: staggered balance, lowers onto one knee, disappointed lowered head, one-knee determined recovering posture. Keep four distinct body poses.
ROW5 FINALE: The finale is a non-graphic physical finishing demonstration: lower ready stance, a forward straight punch, a short knee lift and planted recovery. No victim or blood.
ROW6 MATCH VICTORY: straightens upright, confidently acknowledges result, distinctive celebratory hand/weapon gesture, a quiet final pose; all different from row3.
ROW7 MATCH DEFEAT: exhausted low crouch, sitting or kneeling with shoulders slack, supported one hand on ground, fatigued bowed head. Four intact different poses, not death or gore.
ROW8 SUPER: A physical Dragon of Dojima close combination: planted guard, shoulder and hip turn into a straight punch, a second compact body hook, then controlled recovery. No animal manifestation, beam or magical attack.
IMPORTANT: Do not omit or merge any row. There must be EIGHT rows, FOUR complete different poses per row, THIRTY-TWO cells in total. Do not draw a second character, victim or opponent. Physical actions only as described; no summoned spirit creature. A compact local heat edge or two short motion lines may accent an actual limb/weapon but must never hide or replace the body. All 32 full bodies and props wholly contained inside transparent margins.

records.name: Goro Majima
records.sourceReference: Kiwami 2016 signature snakeskin outfit and Mad Dog knife fighting; adaptation of the combat style rather than literal original animation frames.
records.identity: Goro Majima in Yakuza Kiwami 2016: adult Japanese game character, lean wiry build, black undercut slicked back, black patch covering his LEFT eye, open yellow-tan snakeskin jacket showing chest tattoos, black leather trousers, black gloves, gold chain, dark shoes. A short steel tanto knife held in his right hand; actual small blade, not a katana or bat.
records.superAction: Mad Dog knife technique, a low asymmetrical ready stance, a quick lateral tanto cut with body rotation, a second low sweeping blade motion, then balanced recoil. Actual compact weapon cuts, no duplicated body or summoned animal.
records.finale: The finale is a non-graphic knife kata: low guard, precise horizontal cut, compact rising knife cut and knife safely lowered. No victim, no stabbed body, blood or gore.

records.sourceReference: Hero job uses a bat; Giga Swing damages a target and surrounding enemies. 2020 original version, no Infinite Wealth outfit or invented transformation.

Carry a visibly physical plain rugged metal Hero baseball bat with wrapped grip. Not a glowing sword, not the Infinite Wealth costume.

records.name: Taiga Saejima
records.sourceReference: Yakuza 5 Herculean Spirit prevents flinching in Heat; this project adapts it as bounded self guard with zero enemy damage, not resurrection or healing.
records.identity: Taiga Saejima in Yakuza 5 after the prison escape: very broad heavily built adult Japanese game character, SHORT close-cropped black BUZZ CUT, olive-green heavy parka with tan fur hood trim over black shirt, grey-green camouflage cargo trousers and heavy black boots. Empty fists. Do not preserve the old reference long hair or ponytail.
records.superAction: Herculean Spirit is a defensive self stance: plant both boots wide, lower centre of gravity, brace crossed forearms near chest, then open into an unflinching compact guard. No attack, no outward shockwave, no projectile or enemy impact, no healing hearts or medical symbols. Only a subtle localized amber edge of Heat, kept close to the body.
records.finale: A non-graphic endurance finale: brace against pressure with forearms, turn shoulder to cover head, hold an unwavering grounded guard, then release a controlled breath. NO punch aimed outward, no thrown victim, no explosion.

provenance.sourceReference: Yakuza : Herculean Spirit permet à Taiga Saejima de résister aux interruptions pendant ses attaques chargées ; protection temporaire adaptée de cette capacité.

records.name: Shun Akiyama
records.sourceReference: Yakuza 5 Launch Strike launches with kicks and follows up in the air; actual physical kick choreography, no gun or magical force.
records.identity: Shun Akiyama in Yakuza 5 2012: lean adult Japanese game character, medium tousled dark hair swept back, subtle stubble, burgundy blazer over dark charcoal open-collar shirt, distinctly GREY trousers, black belt and dark leather shoes. Slim relaxed shoulders and long agile legs. Empty hands. Correct the old reference burgundy trousers to grey.
records.superAction: Launch Strike is a physical kicking technique: coil on one planted foot, deliver a rising kick that launches, lift into a compact airborne follow-up kick, then land and recover. The legs perform the action; no punching substitute, gun, fireball or laser.
records.finale: Non-graphic final kicking demonstration: raised knee chamber, high turning kick, controlled downward leg follow-through, land balanced. No victim, no blood, no magic.

provenance.sourceReference: Yakuza 5 : Shun Akiyama utilise le Launch Strike pour projeter un adversaire et enchaîner des coups en l'air ; attaque de jambes, sans fusil ajouté.
